metadata.organism: Gallus gallus (chick epiblast disc Stage EGK XII to HH3+ primitive streak formation)

Rozbicki E, Chuai M, Karjalainen AI, Song F, Sang HM, Martin R, Knölker HJ, MacDonald MP, Weijer CJ (2015). Myosin-II-mediated cell shape changes and cell intercalation contribute to primitive streak formation. Nature Cell Biology 17(4):397-408.

chick_primitive_streak_specimen.species: Gallus gallus whole-mount blastoderm micrographs across HH1 (Koller's sickle crescent), HH2 (condensing midline + Polonaise twin-vortex PIV velocity field), and HH3+ (elongated primitive streak) stained for Wnt8c and Chordin (Vasiev et al. 2010 PLoS ONE 5:e10571 Fig. 1)

governing_equations.section: Saadaoui et al. (2020) Science 367:453-458 Eqs. S1-S12, Figs. 1-4; Serra et al. (2023) mechanochemical active nematic model Eqs. 1-6; Rozbicki et al. (2015) Nat. Cell Biol. 17:397-408

viscous_epiblast_stokes_pde.operator: eta * nabla^2 v + eta_b * nabla(nabla . v) = -nabla . (m * Q) + nabla p_ing
viscous_epiblast_stokes_pde.polonaise_streamfunction: psi(r, theta) = V_dip * r * (1 - (r/R)^2)^2 * sin(theta), with v_r = (1/r) d_theta psi, v_theta = -d_r psi
viscous_epiblast_stokes_pde.circulation_conservation: Gamma_L + Gamma_R = int_{y>0} omega dA + int_{y<0} omega dA = 0, omega(x, -y) = -omega(x, y)
viscous_epiblast_stokes_pde.description: 2D viscous Stokes balance on the circular epiblast disc of radius R = 1.15 mm (area pellucida bounded by the area opaca margin). A posterior-graded marginal tensile Myosin-II ring m(theta) = m_0 + Delta_m cos(theta) drives tangential contraction at the posterior pole and counter-rotating Polonaise twin vortices across the disc.

active_nematic_myosin_feedback_pde.cable_density_evolution: Dm/Dt = d_t m + v . nabla m = alpha_m * m * (1 - m / m_sat) - beta_m * (nabla . v) * m
active_nematic_myosin_feedback_pde.nematic_director_evolution: D Q_{ij} / Dt = lambda_E * m * E^{dev}_{ij} + (omega_{ik} Q_{kj} - Q_{ik} omega_{kj}) - gamma_Q * Q_{ij} + D_Q * nabla^2 Q_{ij}
active_nematic_myosin_feedback_pde.midline_strain_rate: E_{xx}(x, 0) = d_x v_x > 0 (AP extension), E_{yy}(x, 0) = d_y v_y < 0 (mediolateral convergence)
active_nematic_myosin_feedback_pde.ftle_attractor_ridge: Lambda_T(x_0) = (1 / (2 T)) * ln(lambda_max(C(x_0, T))), C = (nabla Phi_0^T)^T (nabla Phi_0^T)
active_nematic_myosin_feedback_pde.description: Strain-rate alignment and self-amplifying mechanical feedback rotate and advect initially tangential posterior Myosin-II cables (Koller's sickle, Q_{yy} > 0, Q_{xx} < 0) into an elongated anteroposterior midline primitive streak ridge (Lambda_T high-FTLE attracting Lagrangian skeleton).

saadaoui_serra_experimental_regimes.section: Saadaoui et al. (2020) Science 367:453-458 Figs. 1-4; Serra et al. (2023) Figs. 2-5; Rozbicki et al. (2015) Nat. Cell Biol. 17:397-408 Figs. 3-6

regimes.label: Wild-Type Chick Epiblast (HH1 Posterior Crescent -> HH3 Linear Midline Primitive Streak + Polonaise Twin Vortices)
FGF Receptor Inhibition (SU5402 / Symmetric Ring Delta_m=0 -> Circular Central Ring Pit, No Linear Streak)
Anterior + Posterior Vg1/Wnt Misexpression (Bipolar Marginal Rings -> Twin Opposing Primitive Streaks & 4-Vortex Flow)
Mesendoderm Ingression Block (SB431542 / Epiboly Without Apical Ingression Sink beta_m=0 -> Broad Short Crescent)
ROCK Inhibition (Y-27632 / Blebbistatin Myosin-II Contractility Collapse -> Arrested Polonaise Flow & No Streak)
